Some elements of this new adventure are [System:Color name=arts_sp ]very different from the 
adventure so far[/System:Color].

The most major points will be introduced on the following pages.

As you progress through the adventure, instead of Chain Attacks,
you will unlock an [System:Color name=arts_sp ]all-new system for performing all-out attacks[/System:Color].

You'll still require a segment of the gauge to revive fallen allies.

In the new adventure, [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Shulk has lost his power to see visions[/System:Color].

This calls for more caution than before when it comes to
your enemies' most powerful attacks.

・Some allies will [System:Color name=arts_sp ]battle in ways not present before[/System:Color].
・The Skill Tree system has been removed.

There are further changes, so keep an eye out for them as you play.

The Ponspectors are an elite band of surveyors from Frontier Village,
split between red, blue and yellow teams. If you can [System:Color name=arts_sp ]befriend members
from all three teams[/System:Color], Shulk and his friends will [System:Color name=arts_sp ]gain access to a new
kind of special attack[/System:Color], so try to seek them out wherever possible!

The full Ponspector brigade numbers [System:Color name=arts_sp ]12 members[/System:Color].

When you recruit one, they may tip you off to [System:Color name=arts_sp ]the location of others[/System:Color].
Locations you've heard of are marked on the map with a [ML:icon icon=map01 ].

Ponspectors on the Giant God's Shoulder have [System:Color name=arts_sp ]issues [/System:Color]they struggle with.

Resolve those issues for them to gain their help in your quest.

In the Collectables section of the main menu, you can access the
[System:Color name=arts_sp ]Ponspector Report [/System:Color]to learn more about the Ponspectors you have
befriended up until that point.

In battle against enemies, Ponspectors will jump in to help Shulk
and his friends on their own initiative.
Each Ponspector has a [System:Color name=arts_sp ]signature move[/System:Color], healing the party,
debuffing the enemies, and so on.

If you perform well in Battle Start Bonding, Burst Bonding, etc.
by pressing [ML:icon icon=btn_b ] at the right time, the Ponspectors may enter a state
of [System:Color name=arts_sp ]High Tension[/System:Color].

Ponspectors in a state of [System:Color name=arts_sp ]High Tension [/System:Color]will join in the battle with
all their strength, and with no slacking off.

High Tension will wear off with time, returning to the usual state.

The Ponspectors are divided up into [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Red[/System:Color], [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Blue [/System:Color]and [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Yellow Teams[/System:Color].

There's a rumour that if members of all three teams ever gather in
one place, [System:Color name=arts_sp ]the Ponspectors' hidden powers[/System:Color] will be unleashed...

Red Team have an [System:Color name=arts_sp ]offensive [/System:Color]signature move.
Blue Team mostly have a [System:Color name=arts_sp ]healing [/System:Color]signature move, but not all of them.
Yellow Team have a [System:Color name=arts_sp ]debuffing [/System:Color]signature move.

By befriending Ponspectors from all three teams, you have unlocked
the ability to perform a special [System:Color name=arts_sp ]coordinated attack [/System:Color]- the [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Union Strike[/System:Color].
Doing so requires spending three bars of the Party Gauge, but it
deals damage to enemies in a wide area and has [System:Color name=arts_sp ]extra effects[/System:Color].

There are three variations to choose from, each with extra effects:
Red Comet - deals [System:Color name=arts_sp ]major damage [/System:Color]to one enemy
Blue Caress - [System:Color name=arts_sp ]heal [/System:Color]and grant [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Regen.[/System:Color] ([ML:icon icon=enh06 ]) and [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Debuff Immu.[/System:Color] ([ML:icon icon=enh14 ]) to allies
Yellow Chaos - [System:Color name=arts_sp ]force Daze[/System:Color] ([ML:icon icon=enh39 ]) and [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Str. Down[/System:Color] ([ML:icon icon=enh27 ]) on enemies in area

The more Ponspectors you're able to befriend,
[System:Color name=arts_sp ]the more powerful their Union Strike will become[/System:Color].

When you use a Union Strike while all three allies are capable of
acting freely, an [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Extra Chance [/System:Color]may sometimes occur.
An Extra Chance lets you [System:Color name=arts_sp ]perform another Union Strike [/System:Color]without
using the Party Gauge. (You cannot choose the same extra effect.)

The probability of an Extra Chance occurring is higher
[System:Color name=arts_sp ]the more Ponspectors are in a state of High Tension[/System:Color].
After a Union Strike, the party's tension will go up, while all
Ponspectors in a state of High Tension will revert to normal.

Fogbeasts are more powerful than their regular monster equivalents.
In addition to that, they also spread a [System:Color name=arts_sp ]riot surge [/System:Color]in a set radius
around themselves, drawing in nearby monsters.

Enemies who come under the effects of the surge will become
aggressive towards Shulk and the party.
Additionally, these enemies will be affected by the [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Riot [/System:Color]Aura ([ML:icon icon=enh35 ]),
[System:Color name=arts_sp ]increasing their level [/System:Color]based on the strength of the Fogbeast.

The [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Riot [/System:Color]Aura ([ML:icon icon=enh35 ]) granted to enemies by Fogbeasts can be removed
in the same way as any other Aura ([ML:icon icon=enh35 ]).
Doing so will remove the Riot Aura's ([ML:icon icon=enh35 ]) level-up effect, making it
crucial in an emergency.

Arts like Shulk's [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Monado Purge[/System:Color] or Melia's [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Mind Blast[/System:Color] have the effect
of removing Auras ([ML:icon icon=enh35 ]) from enemies, making them extremely useful
in fighting Fogbeasts.
You can also remove an enemy's Aura effect ([ML:icon icon=enh35 ]) by [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Dazing[/System:Color] ([ML:icon icon=enh39 ]) them.

When numerous enemies are under the effects of the Riot Aura ([ML:icon icon=enh35 ]),
the [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Yellow Chaos[/System:Color] Union Strike is a very efficient means of removing it.
It allows you to force Daze ([ML:icon icon=enh39 ]) on enemies in a wide area, removing
their Auras ([ML:icon icon=enh35 ]) in the process.
A shop selling Arts Manuals has opened!
What about the coins I already earned?

In the Arts Manual Shop, you can exchange [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Arts Coins[/System:Color] for
Arts Manuals to level up your favourite Arts.

You may obtain Arts Coins when [System:Color name=arts_sp ]defeating unique monsters and
Fogbeasts[/System:Color]. (Defeating a given monster for the first time will always
grant an Arts Coin.)

Arts Coins received for unique monsters and Fogbeasts you defeat
before the shop opens should [System:Color name=arts_sp ]already be in your possession[/System:Color].

You can check the coins you own at the Arts Manual Shop.
Get to know each other in the Quiet Moments

Investigate a [ML:icon icon=map02 ] icon to view the corresponding [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Quiet Moment[/System:Color].

If you don't already meet the conditions for viewing a given scene,
feel free to come back to it when you do!

Any Quiet Moments you've investigated will be added to a list
found under [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Quiet Moments [/System:Color]in the main menu's Collectables section.

You can also use it to check the conditions for viewing each event.

On the Giant God's Shoulder, you can use a tool called an [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Ether Pick[/System:Color] to
[System:Color name=arts_sp ]mine actual gems[/System:Color] from ether deposits, not just crystals.

If you exhaust a given deposit, check back after a while!

As you progress through the story, you may be able to obtain
[System:Color name=arts_sp ]a more efficient Ether Pick[/System:Color].

With a better Ether Pick, you could mine gems of higher rank!
New game elements have been unlocked

・Shulk's weapon's look can be changed in "Future Connected"
・The 8th challenge in the main game's Time Attack is unlocked
・[System:Color name=arts_sp ]Master-level Arts Manuals[/System:Color] have been added to the main game's
 Time Attack item exchange, letting you improve Arts up to level XII

[System:Color name=arts_sp ]Expert mode[/System:Color] lets you store a portion of earned EXP for later use,
rather than being granted to a character immediately. You can
enable it by opening the System menu with [ML:icon icon=btn_plus ], going to [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Expert Mode
[/System:Color]and toggling the option. The option is [System:Color name=arts_sp ]disabled by default[/System:Color].

When Expert mode is enabled with [ML:icon icon=btn_r_stick_on ], all further experience
gained through completing quests, discovering Landmarks and
Locations etc. will be stored as reserve EXP.
If enemies feel a bit too strong...

Switching to [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Casual mode[/System:Color] lets you lower the difficulty of battles.
Simply open the System menu with [ML:icon icon=btn_plus ] and go to [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Options[/System:Color], followed by
Game Settings, then set Casual Mode to on or off. When a prompt
is shown recommending the switch, press [ML:icon icon=btn_minus ] to see the options.

The [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Event Theatre[/System:Color] has been added to the title screen.
There you can view any event cutscenes you've previously seen.

You can change the following options when viewing an event:

・The weather and time of day (not for all events)
・Character appearance (already-acquired looks only)

The [System:Color name=arts_sp ]Expert Mode[/System:Color] section of the System menu ([ML:icon icon=btn_plus ]) lets you manually
adjust party characters' levels. Increasing a character's level will
cost reserve EXP. Reducing a character's level will convert excess
experience points back into reserve EXP.

Level adjustment is performed individually for each character.
Select your desired character with [ML:icon icon=btn_a ], then pick the desired level
using [ML:icon icon=btn_left ] and [ML:icon icon=btn_right ], and then confirm it with [ML:icon icon=btn_a ].

While levelling up, the maximum level available with your current
EXP stockpile will be shown. You cannot lower a character's level
beyond the level they were first introduced at.

You can buy weapons and armour in shops to help your journey go
smoother. In this chapter of your adventure, you will not find armour
among the spoils for defeating monsters, but you may find weapons
that differ from what shops have on offer.

There's no lack of people having problems on the Giant God's Shoulder.
Through completing the quests they give you, you'll obtain rewards
such as money and equipment in new colour variations, suitable for
use as cosmetics.
